name: EOG Resources
description: EOG is one of the largest US independent oil and gas producers: it drills and sells crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas, with no refining or retail. It reports a single business, with production of 1.23 million oil-equivalent barrels a day in 2025 (up 16% from 2024), almost all in the US (Delaware Basin, Eagle Ford, Bakken, Utica and Powder River) plus Trinidad and, since 2025, Bahrain. Revenue comes overwhelmingly from selling its own oil (55 percent of 2025 revenue), gas liquids and gas at market prices, plus a pass-through marketing business (22 percent of revenue) that buys and resells third-party production at almost no profit. It bought Encino Acquisition Partners (Utica gas) on August 1, 2025 for 5.7 billion dollars including debt. Earnings track commodity prices: net income was 4,980 million dollars in 2025 (6,403 million in 2024) and 4,704 million dollars in the first half of 2026 (2,808 million a year earlier) as NYMEX oil averaged 82.57 dollars a barrel (up 22%).
